## Residual variants

- `type(quantile)`: default Dunn-Smyth normal-score quantile residual.
- `type(studentized)`: leverage-standardized quantile residual for unweighted `regress` and `glm`.
- `type(adjusted)`: reserved and currently gated.

## Core references

- Cox and Snell (1968), general residual definition.
- Dunn and Smyth (1996), randomized quantile residuals.
- Warton, Thibaut, and Wang (2017), PIT interpretation cautions.
- `statmod::qresiduals`, `glmtoolbox::residuals2`, `gamlss`, and `topmodels` documentation for R-side residual taxonomy and benchmarks.
